Two indexes serve different audiences:

**wiki/index.md** — for humans (Dataview rendering). The agent NEVER edits this file.

**wiki/index.json** — for agents (machine-readable). Generated by Index Rebuild Procedure.md. This is the ONLY index agents read.

**Dataview fallback** (Q7 = No): index.md gets a static note pointing to index.json.
